author: Denise Thornton
text: I had a great experience with Bar J Septic Services, and I especially want to recognize Brittany in the office. She is incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and genuinely helpful. From the moment I called, she made everything easy to understand and took the time to answer all of my questions without rushing me. It’s rare to find someone who is both so professional and so personable. Brittany truly goes above and beyond, and she made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Bar J Septic Services thanks to her excellent customer service!

author: Kay Cosper
text: What a wonderful experience!  Brittany was so pleasant to help get me scheduled and Justin was here exactly when promised.  I thought the cost was reasonable and it was finished in a jiff.  Very nice service experience!!!
